essence: The cakras disclose their own nature through diverse means such as knots, bases, and phases.
All who are endowed with knowledge teach this own nature openly.
Because of its atomic limitedness and non-manifold nature, those details are not elaborated by us.
May this be for satisfaction in the nectar-essence of one's own bliss.
We expound the sequence of creation, maintenance, and dissolution established in own nature.
